capabilities: Import subtitles from YouTube, Bilibili, podcasts, RSS feeds, and local MP4/SRT/VTT files
Practice sentence-by-sentence dictation and shadowing with recording and playback controls
Look up words in an offline dictionary and manage a vocabulary notebook with FSRS-6 daily review
Generate per-sentence AI translations and study cards via Baidu, DeepSeek, Kimi, or OpenAI-compatible services
Manage subscriptions and colored highlight notes in sidebars, with export to notes or PNG
extras: Desktop-only (mobile still in beta); relies on unofficial YouTube and Bilibili interfaces that may break at any time; AI translation and chat can incur third-party API fees; QQ user group available; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to study languages from video or podcast subtitles with synced playback, word lookup, and spaced vocabulary review.

summary: Turns YouTube, Bilibili and podcast media into timestamped transcripts with dictation, shadowing, vocabulary review and AI translation.
